title: FUEL LINE & CLIPS
summary: Fuel feed pipe and fuel return pipe (the main steel fuel lines) running along the frame rail from the tank area to the front of the engine, held by clips screwed to the frame at several points, plus the short rubber hoses and clamps that join the pipes to the fuel pump at the front (View A).

parts.name: SCREW
parts.name_expanded: Screw – fuel line clip to frame

parts.name: PIPE-FUEL FEED
parts.name_expanded: Pipe – fuel feed (main fuel line, tank to pump)

parts.name: HOSE
parts.name_expanded: Hose – fuel feed pipe to fuel pump

parts.name: HOSE
parts.name_expanded: Hose – fuel return pipe at the fuel pump

fastening.to: frame side rail and kick-up over the rear axle
fastening.qty: one screw per clip, about 7 clip locations
fastening.note: Each clip [2] wraps both the feed pipe [3] and return pipe [4]; screw [1] goes through the clip into the frame. Clips are spaced from the front of the frame rail, past the crossmember, up the kick-up and over the rear of the frame toward the tank.

fastening.to: front end of feed pipe [3] and fuel pump inlet
fastening.note: View A: hose [6] joins the feed pipe to the pump inlet; clamp [5] at each end.

fastening.to: front end of return pipe [4] and the return fitting at the fuel pump
fastening.note: View A: hose [8] joins the return pipe to the return fitting below the pump; clamp [7] at each end.
